node.title: Re^3: Evolution of python
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I suspect the semantic white space makes the Python grammar ambiguous from a theoretical standpoint.

I'd be a bit surprised if that were the case... anyway, there's a [https://docs.python.org/3/reference/grammar.html|Full Grammar specification] available, and the source for the grammar is [https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/master/Grammar/Grammar|here].
